01 / Capabilities

Four processes. One supplier.

Cleaning, coating, drawing, heat treating and delivery, handled by one team on our own equipment.

Wire drawing

Drawn for cosmetics, size control, and specific tensile targets, across all CHQ and IQ grades.

Direct drawDFSARSAIPSAFSIndoor wire storage
.165”1.500”
Draw range

Annealing

Carbon-controlled atmospheres and the flexibility to design specific cycles for special applications.

  • Pusher furnace (Surface Combustion): nitrogen / methanol atmosphere, carbon control
  • Batch furnace (Surface Combustion): nitrogen / endothermic atmosphere, carbon control
SpheroidizedLamellar pearlitic (LPA)Stress relieve

Cleaning & coating

Chemical descaling with sulfuric acid removes scale, oil, dirt and corrosion. Coatings go on in a dip tank for lubricity and corrosion resistance.

  • Zinc phosphate: drawing and cold forming
  • Lime: a dry lubricant for specific applications
  • Lube and polymer: for wire drawing and cold heading

Freight services

Our privately owned fleet gives us the flexibility to service our customers. That vertical integration maximizes delivery performance, from our dock to yours.

03 / Grades & quality levels

Engineered to be cold headed.

CHQ

Cold Heading Quality wire & rod

Steel engineered for the cold heading industry, which forms coils at room temperature into complex shapes. It needs a particular raw material chemistry and surface quality to deliver the right chemical, metallurgical and mechanical characteristics, and to take the compressive forces and deformation of cold heading without losing strength or integrity.

BoltsScrewsRivets
IQ

Industrial Quality wire & rod

Steel suited to cold drawn parts in non-critical applications.

U-boltsPinsHooksWire forms

07 / Who we are

2001

Built for North American leadership.

Emerald Steel Processing was founded in 2001 by Chuck O’Brien to promote North American leadership in steel processing for the cold heading industry. We are a service-oriented steel processor specializing in Just in Time programs that cut inventory levels at the end user, so our customers get raw material when their fast-paced industry needs it.

“To be recognized by our customers, employees, stockholders, suppliers, and communities as the most trusted, innovative, and competent provider of steel and steel processing capable of meeting or exceeding all stakeholders’ expectations.”

Our principles & values

As a member of the Emerald Steel Processing team, I will:

  1. Never knowingly ship a defective product.
  2. Never be satisfied with my current level of professional knowledge.
  3. Always be concerned with my own safety and that of my fellow employees.
  4. Always take pride in the ownership of a customer request, concern, or suggestion, consider it my own responsibility for resolution and an opportunity for improvement.
  5. Never compromise my own integrity or that of my own company.
  6. Always search for new methods, processes, and equipment to continuously improve our products and services for our internal and external customers.
  7. Always celebrate and recognize every individual and collective stakeholder’s contribution toward our shared mission.
Improve

Identify and understand all stakeholder expectations and run continuous improvement programs to meet or exceed them.

Trust

Build relationships with employees, suppliers and stakeholders on trust, with the training, education and resources to serve each other and our customers.

Safety

Promote the safety and health of our employees and the environment of the communities where we operate.
